business_scope.primary_industry_name: Generative Artificial Intelligence and LLM Inference APIs

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France has bilateral investment treaties and double taxation agreements with numerous countries; applicability depends on the investor's residence, the investment structure, treaty status, and any applicable multilateral instrument. Confirm the relevant treaty and its current status before relying on it.

France is a party to the multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters and the Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting, subject to their terms and reservations.
The EU-France legal framework may govern trade and investment matters; EU free-trade agreements are not bilateral treaties concluded by France alone.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Articles L. 561-2 et seq. and R. 561-1 et seq. govern AML/CFT obligations and beneficial-owner identification for persons within scope. Code de commerce, Articles L. 561-46 and R. 561-55 et seq. govern beneficial-owner declarations to the national register. A beneficial owner generally includes a natural person who ultimately owns more than 25% of capital or voting rights, or otherwise exercises control. Registration obligations and access to beneficial-owner information are subject to current French law and applicable EU law; access is not unrestricted public access.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent identity-document authority in the country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, only if required by the receiving French authority and not exempt under an applicable treaty

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate shareholder's certificate of incorporation, current registry extract, constitutional documents, and evidence of authority of its representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or other competent public authority in the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, subject to treaty exemptions and the French filing authority's requirements

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney for incorporation or filing, if used
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Principal and, where applicable, a notary or other competent authentication authority in the country of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, subject to treaty exemptions and French authority requirements

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French translation of foreign-language supporting documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Translator listed as an expert with a French court of appeal or other translator accepted by the receiving authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille is generally required for the French translator's certification; authenticate the underlying foreign public document where required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: A SARL is not subject to a general standalone statutory duty to screen all customers solely by virtue of its legal form. French AML-obliged entities must apply risk-based customer due diligence, identify and assess politically exposed persons under Code monétaire et financier provisions implementing EU AML rules, and comply with applicable UN and EU financial sanctions. Screen founders, beneficial owners, directors, and relevant counterparties against applicable French and EU measures; OFAC screening is not generally a French legal requirement but may be required by US nexus, counterparties, banks, or payment providers. Stripe and banking providers may impose additional screening and source-of-funds controls. Cryptocurrency USDC acceptance may increase counterparty, sanctions, and transaction-monitoring requirements.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); the National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI) also provides trademark and business-name search services
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A SARL name must be stated in its articles and used with the legal-form designation or an accepted abbreviation. French law does not generally require a French-language name or local-script transliteration. The name must be sufficiently distinctive and must not infringe prior company names, trade names, trademarks, or other rights. Registry acceptance does not establish trademark availability.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Terms implying a regulated financial, insurance, banking, legal, or other regulated activity where their use is restricted or would mislead the public
Protected public-authority, state, or official designations, and names subject to specific statutory restrictions
Names infringing existing company names, trademarks, trade names, or other protected rights
No exhaustive general statutory list of all sensitive words applies uniformly; sector-specific restrictions and competent-authority approvals must be checked for the proposed wording
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not generally provide a statutory company-name reservation period comparable to a 30-day reservation. Search the INPI and relevant business registers before filing; conduct a separate trademark clearance search. If a filing is rejected or a formal deficiency is notified through the Guichet unique, follow the stated correction period and submit the requested evidence or amended filing. Request the written grounds and use the administrative or judicial remedy identified in the decision, observing its stated deadline and competent forum. A name-availability search is not a guarantee against later opposition or infringement claims.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A SARL must have a registered office in France. A domiciliation provider may be used if it is authorized and the company enters into a compliant domiciliation agreement. A virtual office may satisfy the registered-office requirement, but it does not by itself establish operational substance, satisfy banking or payment-provider onboarding, or demonstrate compliance with tax, employment, consumer, data-protection, and sector-specific obligations. An AI API business should maintain records and operational arrangements proportionate to its activities and customer base.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No reliable public statistic quantifies unannounced inspection likelihood. Risk is activity-, sector-, and trigger-dependent; do not treat inspection probability as a legally measurable percentage. Relevant authorities may verify registered-office and business information under their respective powers.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL provisions) and R.223-1 to R.223-30 (registration procedures)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and M0 form (déclaration de création d'une personne morale)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; capital may be set at €1. If capital is paid in cash, it must be deposited in a blocked bank account or with a notary (Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations) until registration; in-kind contributions must be fully paid up at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the shareholders, having subscribed to the entire share capital of the company, hereby adopt the Articles of Association as presented. The registered office is fixed at [address], France. The following persons are appointed as managers (gérants) for an indefinite term: [Name] and [Name], each with full powers to act on behalf of the company within the limits of the law and the Articles. The managers are authorized to complete all formalities for registration with the RCS, to open bank accounts, and to engage any professional advisors necessary for the company's establishment. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Sign Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (optional but recommended) or private deed; no government authority at this stage
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Association in French, including company name, registered office address, corporate purpose (ISIC 6201 – computer programming and AI services), share capital amount and division, management structure (gérant), and duration (max 99 years). All shareholders must sign the document. If a notary is used, the notary will authenticate the deed.
required_dossiers: Proof of address of registered office (lease or ownership title)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles are rejected by the registry for incompleteness, correct the deficiencies and re-submit. Notarial authentication can resolve signature or legal form issues.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Share Capital in Blocked Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank or notary (Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the company's name and deposit the subscribed cash capital. Obtain a certificate of deposit (attestation de blocage de fonds) from the bank. If capital is in-kind, a notary must issue a valuation report (rapport du commissaire aux apports) if required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the deposit due to documentation issues, provide additional KYC documents or choose another bank; the certificate can be reissued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish Legal Notice in a Legal Gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal gazette (e.g., Les Affiches Parisiennes, Le Journal Spécial des Sociétés)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft a legal notice containing the company name, legal form (SARL), capital, registered office, corporate purpose, and managers. Submit the notice to an authorized legal gazette for publication. Obtain a copy of the publication (attestation de parution).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is rejected due to missing information, correct and resubmit. Ensure the gazette is approved by the prefecture.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Dossier with the RCS (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) – online via Infogreffe or in person
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file to the RCS: signed Articles of Association, M0 form, proof of capital deposit, legal notice publication, and declarations of managers (no criminal record). Pay the filing fee. The registry will review and issue a K-bis extract upon approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query (e.g., missing document), respond within 15 days with the requested corrections. If the application is rejected, rectify and re-file; appeal possible to the President of the Commercial Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain K-bis Extract and Complete Post-Registration Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, the registry issues the K-bis extract (official proof of legal existence). The company must then register for social security (URSSAF), obtain a SIRET number, and open a permanent bank account. Also, appoint a statutory auditor if required (not mandatory for small SARLs).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis is delayed, contact the registry. For social security registration, use the online portal (guichet-entreprises) and resolve any discrepancies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial licensing required for software/AI services
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required – business activity is classified as non-regulated services under ISIC 6201

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique (via DREAL – Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical industrial activity; office-based operations only
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable – no wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation. Standard office waste disposal per municipal regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for office premises (ERP – Établissement Recevant du Public) if open to public; otherwise, compliance with workplace safety codes (Code du travail) including electrical safety, emergency exits, and occupational health checks. No special structural load inspections required for standard office use.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the impots.gouv.fr portal; VAT registration is managed by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) and the Direction Régionale des Douanes et Droits Indirects for customs-adjacent matters.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident entity must appoint a French tax representative for VAT purposes unless established in the EU or covered by the One Stop Shop regime. Registration for a French VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) is filed with the SIE using Form 1515-sd/1560-sd and is validated through the national SIREN/SIRET registry. Domestic SARLs obtain automatically their SIREN/SIRET upon incorporation, with corporate income tax registration effected via the Déclaration d'identité (Form 14795-SD) and completion of the annual corporate tax return (Form 2065-SD). The tax ID for corporation tax is the SIREN; the VAT ID is issued after objective taxable activity is confirmed.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SARL is by default subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés). It may elect, subject to conditions and shareholder consent, to be taxed as a pass-through under impôt sur le revenu for a maximum five-year period if it qualifies as a small or medium-sized enterprise whose members are natural persons participating in management or in a family SARL. France has no general check-the-box regime; group consolidation is available through the 'intégration fiscale' mechanism for French-incorporated subsidiaries. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD and Article 212 bis CGI apply only to qualified domestic or cross-border arrangements, not as a general entity classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 85,000 for supplies of goods and EUR 37,500 for supplies of services for established small businesses under the franchise en base exemption. Non-established foreign suppliers of digital services have no registration threshold and must register for French VAT or use the EU One Stop Shop form the first euro of taxable supplies where the place of supply is France.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing for domestic B2B transactions applies under the 2026-2028 phased reform, transmitted through approved dematerialized platforms connected to the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF). B2B invoices must be issued in structured electronic formats (EN 16931 or PEPPOL) with guaranteed electronic transmission and audit trail. E-reporting of cross-border B2B and B2C transactions is mandatory; blockchain stamping or real-time 'scontrino' clearance is not used in France. For AI API platform sales, customer-issued invoices and transaction logs must be retained in the PPF-compatible archive for six years and enable indirect tax verification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Tangible goods exported outside the European Union qualify for 0% French VAT under Article 262 CGI if the seller proves dispatch or transport outside the EU within 90 days of invoice date. Offshore services supplied to non-EU B2B customers, including AI API and LLM inference services, are outside the French VAT scope when the place of supply is determined under Articles 259 and 259-A CGI and the customer is outside France/EU; services effective use outside France may be zero-rated. For intra-EU B2B digital supplies, the customer self-assesses VAT under reverse charge. A French SARL must evidence the foreign economic destination by contract terms, IP revenue allocation, customer establishment proof, payment and usage records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'Exportation DAU/ENS) or validated export summary declaration
Transport documentation (Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, CMR or rail consignment note) evidencing departure from France and arrival outside the EU
Commercial invoice referencing the export declaration and zero-rated treatment
Packing list and certificate of origin where applicable
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence confirming receipt of foreign currency/proceeds in France or on the seller's account from the foreign buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: French fiscal authorities examine export zero-rating substantiation through documentary audits, EU-wide customs data reconciliation, and targeted controls on digital service suppliers. Missing or forged proof of export causes immediate VAT reassessment on the underlying turnover, plus late interest of 0.20% per calendar month (intérêts de retard) and penalties under Article 1729 CGI: 40% for deficient declarations made knowingly or in bad faith, 80% for repetitive, dissimulation or abusive practices, and 100% for fraudulent intent or organized offense. In case of false export declarations, criminal fines may reach EUR 750,000 and imprisonment of up to seven years, with customs seizure under the Code des Douanes and publication of sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully convertible Euro currency regime under EU law. Capital account transactions are unrestricted for residents, with profit remittances permitted without prior approval. Standard statistical reporting to the Banque de France applies to transactions exceeding €100,000.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: French exporters must repatriate foreign currency receipts within 90 days; no mandatory central bank surrender or conversion ratio exists. Foreign currency accounts may be maintained for operational liquidity.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for EU-licensed EMI providers under MiCA; legal constraints include mandatory AML/KYC screening for USDC and Stripe-related flows, plus restrictions on proprietary crypto custody.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote video KYC permitted for standard SARL accounts; physical director appearance required only for high-value or enhanced due diligence cases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cryptocurrency or offshore payment volume spikes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds statements, beneficial ownership declarations, and blockchain transaction proofs

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: API token provider payment processor mismatches
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant service agreements, audit logs, and regulatory license copies

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQTY'; full KYC, beneficial ownership, and source-of-funds verification mandatory prior to crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SWIFT MT103 for trade settlements or issuance of Commercial Letters of Credit via correspondent banking networks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts filing (dépôt des comptes annuels) to the Commercial Court Registry (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the local Greffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end (for calendar-year SARL: no later than September 30 following the December 31 close)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the SARL to an administrative fine up to €2,000 (manager personally liable up to €4,000); repeated non-filing may result in judicial dissolution (dissolution judiciaire) and mandatory publication costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) to the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Greffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year, coincident with the annual accounts filing deadline; or within 30 days of any change in beneficiary ownership (e.g., share transfer)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, or incomplete declaration, triggers an administrative fine up to €5,000 for the legal entity and €10,000 for the manager; repeat offenses can support enforcement of corporate dissolution and frozen management rights

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual annual returns attestation to the social security and tax authorities (Déclaration Sociale des Indépendants / DADS) if employees exist
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual declaration due each year by the statutory social security calendar (typically January 31 for previous year's payroll); if no employees, no specific annual filing requirement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines pro-rated on unpaid contributions, plus late-payment penalties and possible criminal enforcement in case of deliberate concealment

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) required for SARLs exceeding two of three thresholds: total balance sheet €4,000,000; net turnover €8,000,000; average permanent employees 50. For an AI API platform below these thresholds, no legal audit is compulsory, but a voluntary audit may be required by financial partners.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (PCG - Plan Comptable Général) for individual statutory accounts, compliant with EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; consolidated IFRS only mandatory for listed groups, optional for others.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Article L.561-47 of the French Monetary and Financial Code, the SARL must file an annual confirmation of its beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) with the RCS. This declaration must identify all natural persons holding directly or indirectly more than 25% of capital or voting rights, or exercising control. Any share transfer changing the UBO list must be filed within 30 days. Failure to update authorizes the registry to issue an injunction and penalties.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registre des mandataires sociaux)
Register of Pledges and Securities (Registre des nantissements)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 190–490 per year (EUR 180–450) for a qualified commercial registered office or domiciliation service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 if no mandatory audit appointed; if voluntarily or statutorily required, typical fee range USD 3,200–8,600 (EUR 3,000–8,000) for a small SARL with no complex consolidations

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate for FY2024), 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 of profit for eligible SMEs
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for SME (turnover < €10m, fully paid-up capital, 75% held by individuals), first €42,500 taxable income; gross-up income tax on certain charges; R&D tax credit 30%
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited years (carryforward) capped at €1,000,000 + 50% of excess taxable profit annually; one-year carryback limited to €1,000,000
